metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Python/Django) with deployable entry point (Django WSGI app served by Apache mod_wsgi), PostgreSQL database. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: PostgreSQL database with CRUD operations on helpdesk tickets, entity lifecycle management (status field), and user-specific data (requester field). Classified as stateful-crud.

findings.title: No Machine-Consumable API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes only HTML-rendered views via Django render_to_response and raw HttpResponse with HTML content. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No machine-consumable API exists. Only HTML pages designed for human browsers.
findings.recommendation: Implement REST API layer with Django REST Framework after upgrading Python and Django to supported versions.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency patterns exist. No idempotency keys, no unique constraint enforcement, no deduplication logic. Agent retries would create duplicate tickets.
findings.gap: Write operations have no idempotency guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints once REST API is implemented.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency patterns found.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Ticketing system exposes write operations (ticket creation/updates). Non-idempotent writes would create duplicate tickets on agent retry.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Only Django session-based authentication exists, designed for human browser sessions. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API key authentication, no mTLS, no service account support.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication with principal attribution in logs.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no log of authenticated principals for write operations. Only a print statement logging search queries without auth context.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail. Cannot prove who performed any action.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging capturing principal, action, resource, and timestamp for all write operations with immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution. No audit trail exists for any operations in this application.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback patterns exist. No saga pattern, no two-phase commit, no undo endpoints. Raw SQL with no transaction management beyond Django autocommit.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations that fail mid-sequence leave partial state with no recovery.
findings.recommendation: Wrap multi-step operations in database transactions with compensation endpoints for business-level rollback.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback or compensation patterns exist.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step ticket workflows have no recovery mechanism on partial failure.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: System stores employee data (requester field). B1: All fields returned without filtering in ticket_list and ticket_search views. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses would expose all fields indiscriminately. No mechanism to scope sensitive fields per caller.
findings.recommendation: Implement response serializers excluding sensitive fields from agent-facing API responses. Add role-based field visibility.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields returned in general API responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Employee data (requester names) returned unfiltered in all query responses. No field-level scoping exists.

b1.reasoning: All fields including requester returned without filtering. Under write-enabled scope, B1 fires as BLOCKER.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation. Single permission grants access to everything.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata or field-level sensitivity annotations.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Employee helpdesk tickets containing employee names and internal information stored with no residency controls, no region configuration, no sovereignty policies.
findings.gap: No data residency controls. Employee PII has no protection against cross-region transmission to LLM providers.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Configure same-region LLM endpoints. Implement technical controls preventing cross-region data transmission.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND employee PII stored with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Employee data subject to privacy regulations stored on single EC2 with no region or residency configuration.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Django's built-in auth provides only basic is_staff/is_superuser flags. No fine-grained permission model, no IAM policies, no role-per-service differentiation.
findings.gap: Cannot create scoped permissions for agent identities. All authenticated users have same access level.
findings.recommendation: Implement granular permission model with resource-level and action-level scoping.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Views perform no permission checks — any request can access ticket data.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only vs write access per resource type.
findings.recommendation: Add permission checks to all views with action-level granularity.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Session cookies only. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity context propagation.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based authentication with on-behalf-of claims.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: SECRET_KEY and database PASSWORD hardcoded in settings.py committed to version control. No secrets management system used.
findings.gap: Credentials in source code. No rotation capability. Leakable via prompt injection or agent bug.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credentials. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Purge from git history.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. No API key management or service account lifecycle.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all users.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key management with per-key revocation.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic/pessimistic locking, no version fields, no conflict resolution logic.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes would create race conditions and data corruption.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields on ticket records.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations for external SMTP dependency.
findings.gap: External dependency failures cascade without protection.
findings.recommendation: Add circuit breaker and timeout configuration for SMTP calls. Implement retry with exponential backoff.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF rules, no application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops could overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with throttling and application-level rate limiting per caller identity.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No max records per run, no spend limits, no bulk operation caps. SQL queries have no LIMIT clause.
findings.gap: Agent errors could affect unlimited records.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits and hard limits on all database operations.

findings.title: PII Exposed in Logs
findings.description: User search queries logged via print statement without redaction. DEBUG=True leaks full request data and credentials in error responses.
findings.gap: PII in logs without redaction. Credentials exposed via debug mode.
findings.recommendation: Set DEBUG=False immediately. Remove print statements. Implement structured logging with PII masking.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state mechanism. Only OPEN status referenced. All writes immediately committed.
findings.gap: No reviewable intermediate state for agent-proposed changes.
findings.recommendation: Add DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW status to ticket lifecycle.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism. No approval endpoints, no configurable flags requiring human confirmation.
findings.gap: All agent actions execute immediately without human oversight.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval workflows for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent frameworks cannot auto-generate tool definitions.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenAPI spec auto-generation once REST API is implemented.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. Errors produce HTML debug pages (DEBUG=True) or raw HTTP 500 responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement global exception handler returning structured JSON errors with error code, message, and retryable flag.

findings.title: State Not Machine-Queryable
findings.description: Query endpoints exist but return HTML, not machine-readable responses. Agents cannot programmatically inspect state.
findings.gap: State queryable by humans via HTML but not by agents.
findings.recommendation: Expose state as JSON REST endpoints.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single EC2, manual deployment. No Docker Compose, no seed data.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create Docker Compose-based local dev environment and separate staging instance.

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Size Limits
findings.description: No pagination, filtering beyond basic status, or result size limits. Queries return all matching rows unbounded.
findings.gap: Agents would get unbounded result sets exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination to all list and search endpoints. Enforce max page size.

findings.title: SQL Injection — Zero Input Validation
findings.description: SQL injection vulnerability. Raw string formatting injects user input directly into SQL queries. No validation, sanitization, or parameterized queries.
findings.gap: Zero input validation at any boundary. SQL injection exploitable.
findings.recommendation: Immediately fix SQL injection with parameterized queries. Add input validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: A 'created' timestamp exists but no 'updated_at'. No freshness signaling headers or metadata.
findings.gap: Limited temporal metadata. No freshness indicators for agents.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps to all tables. Include freshness headers in API responses.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, API contracts, breaking change detection, or migration files.
findings.gap: Schema changes would break agent bindings silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement database migrations and API versioning. Integrate breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing (X-Ray/OpenTelemetry), no structured logging. Only unstructured print statements to stdout.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests completely undiagnosable.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: System degradation undetectable until user reports.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via git pull + Apache restart on single EC2. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: Infrastructure entirely manual. No reproducibility or governance.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as Terraform/CloudFormation. Add PR-based review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Manual deployment only. No automated testing in pipeline.
findings.gap: No pipeline to catch breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract tests.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Recovery requires manual SSH and git checkout.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly roll back broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback (CodeDeploy or blue/green).

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files in repository. README mentions stale unit tests but none present.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage for agent-facing operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite running in CI.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. PostgreSQL on same EC2 with no disk encryption. Data stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Ticket data including employee information stored unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption or migrate to RDS with KMS encryption at rest.

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: All responses are HTML format. Django templates and raw HTML strings. No JSON serialization.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot consume HTML responses effectively.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON as response format when implementing REST API.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to ticket state changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Add SNS/EventBridge integration for ticket lifecycle events.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented or enforced. No rate limit headers in responses.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into consumption limits.
findings.recommendation: Configure rate limit headers when deploying API Gateway.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or monitoring exist.
findings.gap: Agents have no awareness of data completeness or accuracy.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring when modernized.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. No schema documentation beyond SQL in views.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires code archaeology.
findings.recommendation: Document database schema as starting point.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows in this stateful-crud ticketing application.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and system is not documented as critical path.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful (id, subject, requester, priority, status, created). No legacy abbreviations requiring a data dictionary.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind present — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on establishing machine identity, REST API, audit logging, and fixing SQL injection and hardcoded credentials.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement observability, CI/CD, IaC, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Address remaining INFO findings and quality improvements. Add test coverage, event emission, and data quality monitoring.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize application stack (Python 3, Django 4+, REST API)
recommended_actions.rationale: Python 2.7 and Django 1.4 are EOL. No REST API exists. The entire application must be upgraded before any agent integration is possible.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity authentication exists. Agents cannot authenticate or be authorized without a complete identity overhaul.
Hardcoded credentials, SQL injection, and PII in logs are critical security issues regardless of agent integration.
No audit trail exists. Agent actions would be completely unattributable and undiagnosable.
Manual deployment with no rollback, no CI/CD, and no IaC makes the system unsafe to operate as an agent integration surface.
